official_name: Knowledge Atlas Technology Joint Stock Co., Ltd.
blurb: Knowledge Atlas Technology (02513.HK), publicly branded as Z.ai and commonly known as Zhipu AI, became the world's first publicly traded pure-play large-language-model company when it listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on January 8, 2026, raising approximately US$560 million. Founded in 2019 by researchers from Tsinghua University, the company develops the GLM (General Language Model) family of foundation models. Its flagship GLM-5, released in February 2026 with 744 billion parameters and an open-source MIT license, ranked first among open-source models on multiple international benchmarks. The stock surged roughly 30% on February 11, 2026 alone following the GLM-5 launch, and accumulated gains exceeding 250% in its first two months of trading, making it one of the most volatile single-name AI plays in any public market.
nickname_in_market: Chinese Claude (informal, used by Anglophone finance Twitter)
